gallery.filename: 466 Squadron Wellington crew RAF Leconfield 1943 IWM CH 11173.jpg
gallery.title: File:466 Squadron Wellington crew RAF Leconfield 1943 IWM CH 11173.jpg
gallery.description:
The first all Australian crew in Bomber Command to complete a tour of operations (with No 466 Squadron, Royal Australian Air Force) stand in front of their Vickers Wellington bomber at RAF Leconfield, Yorkshire.
Left to right:

Flight Sergeant J P Hetherington (bomb aimer)
Pilot Officer A C Winston (rear gunner)
Pilot Officer J H Cameron (captain)
Flight Sergeant J Samuels (W/O - air gunner)
Pilot Officer J J Allan (navigator)

gallery.title: File:640 Squadron RAF Leconfield Dec 1944.JPG
gallery.description:
Photograph of No. 640 Squadron at RAF Leconfield, Yorkshire, England in December 1944.
Photograph features (not in order): Captain F/O R.Wakeman, DFC; Navigator P/O Reginald William Parr, DFC; Bomb Aimer F/O C.B.Morrison, RCAF, DFC; W/Op. F/Sgt H. Bearyman; Flt.Eng F/Sgt P/McPhie; Mid-upper Gunner F/S H.Thomas; Rear Gunner F/Sgt E.G. Humphries.

Photograph scanned on 3 April 2007. Free use allowed.
